findings.text: follow-on: the fragment's head-arm figures cite revision d151c1fcf and 209.87s, while the arm log it is drawn from (head-arm.log) records revision d39b7e8be and 195.90s at the same pass/fail counts; the head figures were not regenerated after the test file's final commit, so a reader comparing fragment to log finds a revision mismatch.

follow-on: the renew_producer_lease signature exceeds the line width and is not ruff-format compliant; ruff format --check reports runs.py with 2 deviation hunks at base against 3 at head, the new hunk being this signature, which adds one finding against the repository rule that a commit adds none.

follow-on: renewals is incremented whenever renew_producer_lease returns non-None, and the throttle path returns the record without writing, so the assert renewals >= 5 does not measure five real renewals; the assertion is satisfied by the same helper it claims to exercise.

findings_note: the head-arm revision the evidence fragment cites is not the one the arm log records; the gate, arms and negative control were all read from the reviewed run directory
